title: Expose hide and unhide character verbs over triggers/behaviors.py hiding edges and unify hidden state perception

sections.what: Expose hide and unhide (in/behind/under cover) as playable character verbs over the existing engine/triggers/behaviors.py hiding system and unify hidden checks across perception and combat.
sections.why: engine/triggers/behaviors.py (lines 307-366) already adds 'hidden' graph edges and toggles player.hidden, engine/serialization.py (line 695) persists p.hidden, and engine/combat.py (lines 231-239) respects hidden invisibility. Yet characters cannot invoke hide/unhide via action_verbs.py or /api/action, and examine_actions.py (line 531) checks player.state instead of player.hidden.
sections.how: 1. Extract shared hide/unhide helper over engine/triggers/behaviors.py (lines 307-366) supporting both targeted cover (`hide_in`/`hide_behind`/`hide_under` when a `hideable` prop exists) and stealth posture hide in cover/shadows, plus `unhide`.\n2. Register `hide` and `unhide` in engine/action_verbs.py, PlanGrounding.PLAN_INTENT_ACTS, routes/action_handlers.py, and contextual-actions.ts (surfacing hide when threat/danger or hideable cover exists, and unhide when `player.hidden` is true).\n3. Reconcile `player.hidden` vs `player.state in ('hidden', 'stealthed')` in examine_actions.py (line 531), scene_snapshot.py, and `player_manager.is_visible` so hidden characters stay concealed from casual observation until spotted by Stealth/Perception or taking an overt breaking action.
sections.verify: 1. Run pytest verifying hide/unhide commands set/clear player.hidden + hidden edges, mask hidden characters from casual room perception and combat targeting, and reveal via active search/Perception or overt attack.\n2. Run npm run build:ts and node tools/unit/run.cjs covering PlanGrounding and contextual-actions hide/unhide surfacing.

acceptance.text: hide and unhide (with cover target options matching triggers/behaviors hide_in, hide_behind, hide_under and bare hide/sneak fallback) are registered in engine/action_verbs.py, PlanGrounding, contextual-actions.ts, and routes/action_handlers.py.

player.hidden and 'hidden' spatial edges are checked consistently across player_manager.is_visible, engine/items/examine_actions.py (line 531), engine/scene_snapshot.py, and room-context.ts perception.
Taking loud/violent action or failing a stealth contest against active searchers clears concealment and records clear feedback.

custom.browser_ui:
Intended UI home: Agent Turn Modal Available Actions (`contextual-actions.ts`) and item action brackets on `hideable` furniture/cover.

Current availability: engine/triggers/behaviors.py (lines 307-366) implements hide_in/hide_behind/hide_under/unhide and engine/combat.py (lines 231-239) respects hidden targets, but no hide/unhide player command exists.

Manual verification steps:
1. Place a character in an area containing a `hideable` prop and execute `hide behind <prop>` or `hide`, then check whether another character's room prompt lists them.
2. Execute `unhide` or take an overt action and verify concealment clears cleanly.
